config.field.annotate_bam.help: Generate per-unit peak-assignment sidecars from the resolved unit BAMs; despite the name, no annotated BAM is kept. Default: off.
config.field.annotate_bam.label: Annotate BAM
config.field.annotate_peak_source.help: Peak view used for gene annotation and all peak sidecars and matrices: resolved keeps resolved sub-peaks, merged uses the post-filter merged view. Default: resolved; allowed values: resolved, merged.
config.field.annotate_peak_source.label: Annotate peak source
config.field.bulk_gene_gtf.help: Optional bulk-derived gene-locus GTF produced by prepare-bulk, used for reference setup and peak annotation. No default.
config.field.bulk_gene_gtf.label: Bulk gene GTF
config.field.bulk_window_gtf.help: Optional bulk-derived 3'UTR window GTF produced by prepare-bulk, used for reference setup and peak annotation. No default.
config.field.bulk_window_gtf.label: Bulk window GTF
config.field.cb_tag.help: BAM tag holding the corrected cell barcode, used by dedup, barcode rewriting, sidecars and matrices. Default: CB.
config.field.cb_tag.label: Cell barcode tag
config.field.chrom_sizes.help: Two-column, tab-separated chromosome sizes file for the same assembly as the BAMs and GTF. Required.
config.field.chrom_sizes.label: Chromosome sizes
config.field.count_matrix.help: Generate per-sample peak-cell count matrices; this also enables peak-assignment sidecars. Default: off.
config.field.count_matrix.label: Count matrix
config.field.coverage_scaling.help: Which coverage families are multiplied by their library-size factor before peak calling: none, expr, polyA or both. Default: none; this also decides whether the scaled or unscaled fixed threshold applies.
config.field.coverage_scaling.label: Coverage scaling
config.field.debug.help: Stored in the run configuration, but no current pipeline step uses it; use Verbose logging for more logs. Default: off.
config.field.debug.label: Debug
config.field.dedup_method.help: Method passed to umi_tools dedup --method; it runs only for undeduplicated inputs unless Rededuplicate BAMs is on. Default: directional; allowed values: directional, unique, cluster, adjacency.
config.field.dedup_method.label: Dedup method
config.field.dedup_stats.help: Write umi_tools --output-stats files next to the deduplicated unit BAMs. Default: off.
config.field.dedup_stats.label: Write dedup stats
config.field.deepcps.help: Adds a per-site DeepCPS score and localisation after annotation. Off by default. Scores are annotations only: counts, filtering and the native annotation do not change.
config.field.deepcps.label: Score sites with DeepCPS
config.field.deepcps_batch_size.help: Windows per inference batch, 1 to 512. Affects speed and memory only.
config.field.deepcps_batch_size.label: DeepCPS batch size
config.field.deepcps_model_dir.help: Read-only directory with the supplied weights and calibration files. Every file is checked against the model manifest's SHA256 pins. Required when DeepCPS is on.
config.field.deepcps_model_dir.label: DeepCPS model directory
config.field.deepcps_model_manifest.help: Optional. Leave empty to use the model manifest shipped with this checkout.
config.field.deepcps_reference_sha256.he: Optional 64-character SHA256 of the reference FASTA. When set, the FASTA bytes must match it.
config.field.deepcps_threads.help: CPU threads for inference, 1 or 2. Affects speed only.
config.field.deepcps_threads.label: DeepCPS threads
config.field.exp_dynamic_threshold_alpha: Multiplier applied to the median, mean or median_nonzero statistic for dynamic expression thresholds. Default: 1.0.
config.field.exp_dynamic_threshold_floor: Lower bound on the dynamic expression threshold when the statistic is median, mean or median_nonzero. Default: 0.0.
config.field.exp_dynamic_threshold_norma: Fraction of the maximum gene coverage used as the expression threshold when the statistic is max_norm_fixed. Default: 0.3; range [0, 1].
Length-weighted per-gene coverage statistic for dynamic expression thresholds; required in dynamic mode, no default. Allowed values: median, mean, median_nonzero (threshold = max(floor, alpha × statistic)) or max_norm_fixed (threshold = normalized × maximum gene coverage).
config.field.exp_peak_threshold_mode.hel: How expression peaks are thresholded: fixed uses one depth threshold, dynamic computes a threshold per gene. Default: fixed; allowed values: fixed, dynamic.
config.field.force_dedup_bams.help: Run umi_tools dedup even for input rows that declare is_deduped=1. Default: off.
config.field.force_dedup_bams.label: Rededuplicate BAMs
config.field.force_split_bams.help: On: split every whole-BAM input into per-contig BAMs before dedup; off (default): whole BAMs that need dedup are deduplicated directly per indexed contig. An input row with requires_split=1 selects the split route for that input only.
config.field.force_split_bams.label: Split before dedup
config.field.gene_gtf.help: Primary gene annotation GTF; it must use the same assembly as the BAMs and chromosome sizes. Required.
config.field.gene_gtf.label: Gene GTF
config.field.inputs.help: CSV defining samples and BAM paths, with required columns sample_id and source_path. Required; for an undeduplicated whole BAM, requires_split=0 (default) dedups directly per indexed contig and requires_split=1 materializes contig BAMs first, while is_deduped=1 marks a source as already deduplicated.
config.field.inputs.label: Inputs CSV
config.field.intronic_misprimed_ratio_th: Inclusive mispriming ratio threshold for intronic polyA sites, used only in terminal-aware mode and ignored in legacy mode. Default: 0.5; range [0, 1].
config.field.keep_annotate_bam_temp.help: Deprecated and has no effect; peak annotation now writes sidecars instead of temporary annotated BAMs. Default: off.
config.field.keep_merge_temp.help: Keep merge chunk BAMs and symlinks after successful concatenation; otherwise they are removed. Default: off.
config.field.keep_merge_temp.label: Keep merge temp
config.field.materialize_strand_bams.hel: Retain compatibility-only plus/minus BAM and BAI files for each unit and cohort. This does not change scientific coverage, peaks, or matrices: coverage always reads unstranded cohort BAMs and applies bedtools strand filters. Off by default.
config.field.max_dedup_workers.help: Concurrent per-unit umi_tools dedup tasks; affects speed and memory, not results, and lower values help on rotational or shared storage. Default: 4; 0 uses an automatic CPU-based cap.
config.field.max_dedup_workers.label: UMI dedup task workers
config.field.max_extract_workers.help: Concurrent polyA extraction child processes and optional strand-BAM materialization tasks; affects speed and memory, not results. Default: 16; 0 uses an automatic CPU-based cap.
config.field.max_extract_workers.label: PolyA extraction task workers
config.field.max_filter_workers.help: Concurrent BAM filter and barcode-suffix rewrite tasks; affects speed and memory, not results. Default: 4; 0 uses an automatic CPU-based cap.
config.field.max_filter_workers.label: Filter/barcode task workers
config.field.max_merge_workers.help: Concurrent chromosome merge and final cohort BAM cat tasks; affects speed and memory, not results. Default: 4; 0 uses an automatic CPU-based cap.
config.field.max_merge_workers.label: Cohort merge task workers
config.field.max_split_workers.help: Concurrent sample-contig BAM split tasks; affects speed and memory, not results. Default: 4; 0 uses an automatic CPU-based cap.
config.field.max_split_workers.label: BAM split task workers
config.field.merge_distance.help: Distance for clustering expression intervals and for the final post-filter peak merge; must be ≥ 0. Required.
config.field.merge_distance.label: Expr merge distance
config.field.merge_distance_polyA.help: Distance for clustering polyA intervals; must be ≥ 0. Leave empty to inherit Expr merge distance.
config.field.merge_distance_polyA.label: PolyA merge distance
config.field.merge_temp_dir.help: Directory for per-contig merge chunks; a fast external disk can reduce I/O pressure, and the location does not change results. Default: <output directory>/<run ID>/merged_cohort.
config.field.merge_temp_dir.label: Merge temp directory
config.field.merge_thread.help: Value passed to samtools merge -@ inside each concurrent merge task; affects speed and memory, not results. Default: 4; 0 requests no extra samtools threads.
config.field.merge_thread.label: samtools threads per merge
config.field.minMAPQ.help: Unmapped reads and reads with mapping quality below this value are rejected during polyA extraction. Default: 0.
config.field.minMAPQ.label: Min MAPQ
config.field.minpolyA.help: Minimum strand-appropriate A/T count, and minimum terminal soft-clip length, for polyA read extraction. Default: 10.
config.field.minpolyA.label: Min polyA length
config.field.misprime_A_count.help: A read is classified as misprimed (internally primed) when its assessment window contains at least this many A bases, or T bases for reverse reads. Default: 8.
config.field.misprime_A_count.label: Misprime A count
config.field.misprime_in.help: Number of aligned read bases examined at the strand-appropriate end for mispriming assessment. Default: 10.
config.field.misprime_in.label: Misprime window
config.field.misprimed_ratio_threshold.h: Peaks are kept when misprimed_reads / total_polyA_reads is at or below this value; peaks without same-strand polyA support always fail. Default: 1 (no removal by ratio alone); range [0, 1].
config.field.n_threads.help: Legacy setting kept for old command lines. It has no effect; use the worker settings instead.
config.field.n_threads.label: Legacy global threads
config.field.n_threads_bam_annotation.he: featureCounts -T threads requested inside each feature-assignment task (default: 4; values below 1 become 1); affects speed, not results. In the current release the effective value comes from the SCPOLYA_FEATURECOUNTS_ANNOTATED_BAM_THREADS environment variable, which defaults to 1.
config.field.n_threads_merge.help: Legacy setting kept for old command lines. It has no effect; use the worker settings instead.
config.field.n_threads_merge.label: Legacy merge tool threads
config.field.n_workers.help: Concurrent tasks for UMI counting, peak calling and annotation, count/RNA matrices and matrix summaries; affects speed and memory, not results. Default: 4; 0 selects min(32, detected CPU count).
config.field.n_workers.label: General analysis task workers
config.field.n_workers_annotate.help: Concurrent peak and RNA-gene feature-assignment sidecar tasks; affects speed and memory, not results. Default: 0, which inherits General analysis task workers.
config.field.n_workers_annotate.label: Feature assignment task workers
config.field.nonA_allowed.help: Maximum number of non-A/non-T bases allowed across the entire terminal soft clip of a polyA tail. Default: 1.
config.field.nonA_allowed.label: Max non-A bases
config.field.output_dir.help: Parent directory for all runs; this run is written to <output directory>/<run ID>. Required.
config.field.output_dir.label: Output directory
config.field.polyA_dynamic_threshold_alp: Multiplier applied to the median, mean or median_nonzero statistic for dynamic polyA thresholds. Default: 1.0.
config.field.polyA_dynamic_threshold_flo: Lower bound on the dynamic polyA threshold when the statistic is median, mean or median_nonzero. Default: 0.0.
config.field.polyA_dynamic_threshold_nor: Fraction of the maximum gene coverage used as the polyA threshold when the statistic is max_norm_fixed. Default: 0.3; range [0, 1].
config.field.polyA_dynamic_threshold_sta: Length-weighted per-gene coverage statistic for dynamic polyA thresholds; required in dynamic mode, no default. Allowed values: median, mean, median_nonzero (threshold = max(floor, alpha × statistic)) or max_norm_fixed (threshold = normalized × maximum gene coverage).
config.field.polyA_peak_threshold_mode.h: How polyA peaks are thresholded: fixed uses one depth threshold, dynamic computes a threshold per gene. Default: fixed; allowed values: fixed, dynamic.
config.field.psi_min_gene_umis.help: In matrix summaries, PSI and weighted 3'UTR values are masked for gene-cell pairs with fewer total gene UMIs than this. Default: 1.
config.field.psi_min_gene_umis.label: PSI min gene UMIs
config.field.quantification_mode.help: Quantification profile: legacy keeps the existing quantification model and output names, while terminal-aware enables optional terminal/intronic quantification. Default: legacy; allowed values: legacy, terminal-aware.
config.field.quantification_mode.label: Quantification mode
config.field.reference_fasta.help: The genome FASTA the BAMs were aligned to, with an existing .fai index. Names and lengths must match the BAM header exactly; nothing is renamed or re-indexed. Required when DeepCPS is on.
config.field.reference_fasta.label: Alignment reference FASTA
config.field.remove_mt.help: Remove the mitochondrial contig (M/MT) from the run's contig set. Default: off.
config.field.remove_mt.label: Remove mitochondrial reads
config.field.repair_moved_run.help: Repair run-internal absolute paths in generated input tables and state.sqlite, backing up the previous records, then continue the run. Default: off; cannot be combined with the dry-run option.
config.field.repair_moved_run.label: Repair moved run
config.field.repair_moved_run_dry_run.he: Preview moved-run path repairs and exit without modifying the run or running the pipeline. Default: off; cannot be combined with Repair moved run.
config.field.rna_gene_matrix.help: Generate per-sample RNA gene-cell tables from the resolved unit BAMs using the gene GTF, independently of the peak outputs. Default: off.
config.field.rna_gene_matrix.label: RNA gene matrix
config.field.run_id.help: Experiment name used for the run directory and output naming; characters other than letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' are replaced with '_'. Required.
config.field.run_id.label: Run ID
config.field.scaled_depth_threshold.help: Fixed depth threshold for scaled expression peaks; coverage at or above it is retained. Used only in fixed mode when coverage scaling is expr or both; must be ≥ 0, no default.
config.field.scaled_depth_threshold_poly: Fixed depth threshold for scaled polyA peaks; coverage at or above it is retained. Used only in fixed mode when coverage scaling is polyA or both; must be ≥ 0, no default.
config.field.species.help: Input species; selects the standard contig set for the run. Required; allowed values: mouse, human, fly, worm.
config.field.species.label: Species
config.field.summarize_matrix.help: Generate peak metadata, gene-cell tables, cell-gene matrices, weighted 3'UTR length tables and PSI tables; this also enables sidecars and count matrices. Default: off.
config.field.summarize_matrix.label: Summarize matrix
config.field.tools_seed.help: Random seed passed to umi_tools dedup; keep it fixed for reproducibility. Default: 2026.
config.field.tools_seed.label: Tools random seed
config.field.umi_tag.help: BAM tag holding the UMI, used by umi_tools and matrix counting. Default: UB.
config.field.umi_tag.label: UMI tag
config.field.unscaled_depth_threshold.he: Fixed depth threshold for unscaled expression peaks; coverage at or above it is retained. Used only in fixed mode when coverage scaling is none or polyA; must be ≥ 0, no default.
config.field.unscaled_depth_threshold_po: Fixed depth threshold for unscaled polyA peaks; coverage at or above it is retained. Used only in fixed mode when coverage scaling is none or expr; must be ≥ 0, no default.
config.field.verbose.help: Log at DEBUG instead of INFO level, including console output; does not change results. Default: off.
config.field.verbose.label: Verbose logging
config.group.advanced_diagnostics_help: Reproducibility seed and diagnostic output controls.
config.group.cohort_merge_help: Concurrent merge jobs and samtools threads inside each job.
config.group.feature_assignment_help: Concurrent sidecar jobs and featureCounts threads per job.
config.group.general_analysis_help: Shared task parallelism for UMI, peak, and matrix stages.
config.group.legacy_help: Accepted for historical CLI compatibility but not consumed.
config.group.polya_extraction_help: PolyA extraction and optional strand-BAM materialization task pools.
config.group.preprocessing_help: Per-unit BAM split, filter, barcode, and dedup task pools.
config.group.shared_help: Settings shared by expression and PolyA peak calling.

diff.approve.check_required: Confirm that you reviewed the plan
diff.approve.confirm: I reviewed this plan and want to run it
diff.approve.detail: This runs exactly this plan.json. The adapter repeats all its checks before it runs anything.
diff.approve.full_plan_note: This is the exact file the SHA256 above refers to. The hash is checked again when you submit.
diff.approve.stale: This plan can no longer be executed as bound
diff.approve.title: Review and run this plan
diff.backend.moved_plan: The plan directory was moved after it was prepared. Prepare the plan again in its new location.
diff.diagnostic_note: Eligibility-only plans and descriptive results carry no inference; use them to judge feasibility, not as differential findings.
diff.endpoint_testability_note: Length availability/moderation and actual inference remain backend decisions.
diff.error.attempt: This result failed verification and is not shown
diff.error.attempt_next: Files in this attempt folder changed or are incomplete. Do not edit them; run the plan again into a new, empty attempt folder.
diff.error.plan: This plan could not be read
diff.error.plan_next: Check that the path points to a plan folder written by the planner and that it can be read.
diff.error.refused_next: Fix what the reason names (plan inputs, eligibility or output folder), make a new plan, then run it into a new, empty attempt folder.
diff.error.unknown_next: Open a plan folder or an attempt folder; other folders are not recognised here.
diff.exact_values: Exact values as written; NA kept
diff.forget_detail: Only the UI's list entry is removed. The plan or result folder and its files stay on disk; you can open it again later.
diff.intro.approve.detail: A person reviews exactly what the plan will run (its settings and SHA256) and starts it here.
diff.intro.approve.title: Review and run
diff.intro.note: Cells are not biological replicates: inference compares donor pseudobulks. Donor and condition labels come from your metadata and cannot be verified here.
diff.intro.plan.detail: scpolya-operator differential-apa plan aggregates raw counts and checks donors, design rank and runtime. It writes a new plan directory.
diff.intro.plan.title: Plan
diff.intro.read.detail: Open the plan or attempt directory. Results are read with the adapter's own verifying reader; values are shown exactly as written, NA included.
diff.intro.read.title: Read results here
diff.launched_tip: Runs started from this interface, including refused ones. Runs started from the command line are not counted.
diff.limit.issuer: Approval hashes bind intent and bytes; issued_by is not cryptographic issuer authentication.
diff.limit.native: Existing native denominators, distal ties, unavailable values and separate endpoint families remain authoritative.
diff.limit.plan_binding: Execution is bound to the exact plan file bytes (plan sha256 recorded in attempt.json).
diff.limit.preflight: Eligibility diagnostics are preflight checks, not statistical results or calibrated FDR evidence.
diff.limit.provenance: Supplied donor, condition and upstream catalogue provenance cannot be independently authenticated by this adapter.
diff.limit.single_donor: One donor or one observed condition does not establish population differential APA.
diff.link_error: The linked analysis folder could not be opened: {path}
diff.manual.title: Run from a terminal instead
diff.next.BLOCKED_ELIGIBILITY: No units passed the coverage gates. Adjust the inputs or gates and plan again in a new directory.
diff.next.BLOCKED_RUNTIME: R or a requested package could not be loaded. Install it in the declared library, then make a new plan in a new directory.
diff.next.FAILED: Planning failed; see the plan for details. Retry in a new directory.
diff.next.PREPARED_ELIGIBILITY_ONLY: This plan has no contrast. It reports conditions and donor counts only and cannot be executed.
diff.next.blocked_eligibility: The data did not meet the eligibility rules, so no test was run. Review the eligibility card; a new plan with other groups or thresholds may qualify.
diff.next.blocked_runtime: The R environment was not usable. Check the R tools on the Settings page, then run the plan again into a new, empty attempt folder.
diff.next.failed: The attempt failed. Read the error and the attempt logs, fix the cause, then run the plan again into a new, empty attempt folder. This failed folder is kept as a record.
diff.next.other: This plan cannot be executed in its current state.
diff.next.ready: The plan passed its checks. Review what it will run, then start it: the UI runs execute on exactly this plan (this SHA256) into a new directory.
diff.open_detail: Choose a plan directory (with plan.json) or an attempt directory (with attempt.json) written by scpolya-operator differential-apa.
diff.progress.envelope_scope: systemd scope: 2 CPU, 4 GiB, no swap
diff.progress.orphaned: The execute process has ended but attempt.json still says running; it was probably interrupted. Run again into a new directory.
diff.progress.title: Execution
diff.readable_note: Rounded to 4 significant digits; hover a cell for the exact value.
diff.readable_tip: Rounded numbers, decoded unit ids, sorting and filtering. Turn off for the exact values page by page.
diff.sort_capped: Only the first {count} rows were read; filtering and sorting cover those rows only. Turn off Readable to page through the whole table.
diff.verified_detail: Every output file matches the hash recorded in attempt.json, and the backend's completion record agrees.

help.intro: Hover the ? next to a parameter to see what it does, usually with its default and allowed range.
help.term.attempts.detail: One run directory can be executed several times. Each execution is an attempt with its own invocation_id; rerun and continue add attempts and keep the old ones.
help.term.compare_mode.detail: The genome browser's compare mode takes two completed runs with recorded invocation history that use the same FASTA, index and GTF. Variants of a parameter study are compared together in study mode.
help.term.eligibility.detail: A differential APA plan first checks the design: enough donors per condition, no confounding, enough units. Eligibility-only plans stop there. Inference candidates can be reviewed and run; results are still decided by the backend.
help.term.external_approval.detail: Differential APA first writes a plan. You review exactly what it will run (settings and plan SHA256) and start it on the Differential APA page or from a terminal. No approval file is needed.
help.term.missing.detail: A final output the configuration should produce is absent or incomplete. Missing outputs are not repaired or filled from other runs.
help.term.not_produced.detail: The run stopped or is still running, so this output has not been made yet. Missing is reserved for finished runs whose expected output is absent.
help.term.output_actions.detail: Before a rerun, the review lists each output: rewritten in place (same path, new content), written to a new location (the settings change the file name), newly enabled, or no longer generated. Unaffected outputs are reused.
help.term.path_mapping.detail: If a run directory was moved, a mapping points the old path to the new place. It only changes where files are read; the original config and hash stay as provenance.
help.term.reference_only.detail: Model scores, optional modes and diagnostic-only analyses carry this tag. They help you judge, but are not conclusions on their own.
help.term.refresh_sync.detail: Refresh re-reads the UI's own records and the folders' invocation history. Sync status additionally checks running jobs' processes and updates their status.
help.term.rerun_continue.detail: Rerun recomputes affected tasks with a new configuration. Continue keeps the original configuration and finishes incomplete tasks. Both preview the impact first.
help.term.run_kinds.detail: Command-line runs were started outside this UI and are found from the folder's invocation records; their artifacts are not snapshotted. UI runs were started here and carry a full snapshot of configuration and expected outputs.
help.term.snapshot.detail: Outputs of an older attempt are shown only when an immutable snapshot exists. Current files in a shared directory are never presented as old results.
help.term.structured_status.detail: Completion is read only from task records in state.sqlite, never inferred from file names or log text. A log can say “done” while the run still shows unknown.
help.term.terminal_aware.detail: An optional quantification mode for terminal and intronic sites. It adds terminal and intronic APA tables; the default legacy mode keeps the established output names.
help.term.variants.detail: A parameter study runs each variant in the same results folder, one after another. On the Runs page they appear as attempts of that folder, labelled with the variant; the folder holds the outputs of the most recent attempt.

If the original folder still exists, register that one instead; otherwise start a new run to get results the UI can open.

run_setup.base_switch_detail: Loading another base config replaces the draft. Your {count} {count|change|changes} will be lost.
run_setup.command_empty: Build a command to inspect the exact CLI call.
run_setup.confirm_continue_message: Relaunch the identical command against this run's task database. Review task state and partial outputs before continuing.
run_setup.confirm_start_message: Review the current form snapshot before starting this run.
run_setup.continue_config_changed: Continue does not allow execution config changes. Restore the interrupted run's exact values or use Rerun.
run_setup.continue_config_unavailable: The interrupted run's exact execution config cannot be verified. Continue remains blocked.
run_setup.continue_experimental_warning: Experimental: relaunches the identical command against this run's task database. Completed tasks are skipped; an interrupted task may run again and partial files may be overwritten.
run_setup.continue_invalid_status: Continue requires an interrupted attempt; the selected record is {status}.
run_setup.continue_missing_state: Continue requires the original task database, which is missing at {path}.
run_setup.continue_select_interrupted: Select a failed, stopped, exited, or cancelled run record as the base config.
run_setup.continue_state_unreadable: Continue requires readable current task state. Completion is {completion}; parameter ledger is {ledger}.
run_setup.continue_uninitialized_warning: Experimental: no current completed-task state exists yet. The identical command will restart against this task database, and partial files may be overwritten.
run_setup.destination_existing: Writes into an existing results folder
run_setup.destination_local_copy: This is the local copy of the base run (recorded under {recorded}); the preview compares settings with the base run here.
run_setup.destination_moved_history: This folder's run history was recorded at another location. Check it with the moved-run repair dry-run before relying on reuse.
run_setup.destination_new_detail: Nothing is reused in a new folder: every task runs. The impact preview compares settings with the base run only.
run_setup.destination_no_rewrites: No existing artifact will be rewritten; existing results are reused.
run_setup.destination_recorded_blocked: Start is unavailable: the output folder is the run's recorded location, which this workspace maps elsewhere. Choose the output folder explicitly.
run_setup.destination_recorded_detail: This workspace maps that path to {mapped} for reading results, but a run writes exactly to the output folder set here; mappings are not applied. Starting would write a separate run at the recorded path, so the reuse shown in the preview would not apply. Choose the output folder explicitly.
run_setup.destination_recorded_title: This output folder is where the run was recorded, not the local copy
run_setup.destination_rewrites: Outputs whose settings changed are rewritten in place ({count} {count|location|locations} below); unaffected results are reused.
run_setup.destination_use_mapped: Write to the local copy instead ({path})
run_setup.diff_explainer: Comparing {base} against the proposed rerun config.
run_setup.form_unavailable: Structured config controls are not available
run_setup.json_invalid: The JSON could not be read at line {line}, column {column}: {reason}. Nothing was applied.
run_setup.json_not_object: The config JSON must be an object ({{ … }}).
run_setup.launch_inputs_blocked: The engine would refuse this launch. Fix the problems listed in the review first.
run_setup.launch_inputs_title: This launch would stop before running any task
run_setup.launch_problem.immutable_chang: {setting} is fixed for this run folder ({stored}); the proposal uses {value}. Keep the stored value or choose a new run folder.
run_setup.launch_problem.missing_input: {setting}: {value} does not exist on this computer.
run_setup.launch_problem.missing_source: Input table, sample {setting}: source BAM {value} does not exist on this computer.
run_setup.launch_problem.moved_without_r: This run folder was recorded at another location, and its input tables still name that location. Turn on "Repair moved run" so the engine rewrites them first (previous versions are kept as backups).
run_setup.normalized_note: Normalized-only fields ({keys}) differ in storage but resolve to the same execution values.
run_setup.raw_json_detail: Edit the full configuration as JSON. Applying it replaces the form values.
run_setup.section_all_only: No common settings here; {count} more {count|is|are} under All settings.
run_setup.state_diagnostics: Notes from reading the run state
run_setup.state_diagnostics_detail: Configuration can still be reviewed; completion and ledger checks remain fail-closed.
run_setup.terminal_aware_note: Terminal-aware quantification adds terminal and intronic APA tables.
run_setup.annotation_schema_title: Annotation schema: use a new run folder
run_setup.annotation_schema_new_root: This run folder already holds site annotation outputs of an older format. Running here adds new outputs beside them, after which run tables, genome tracks and site scores refuse the folder as mixed. Choose a new Run ID or output folder; the existing outputs are kept unchanged.

run_setup.workflow_group.retained_compat: Optional retained files for external consumers and troubleshooting; these controls do not select worker or thread counts.

runs.sync_tooltip: Check running jobs and update their status

settings.agent.title: Agent mode
settings.igv_reference_detail: Used only to draw sequence in the genome browser. The pipeline does not read it.
settings.inputs_detail: Paths come from the saved run configuration, with this workspace's path mappings applied. Only existence is checked, not content.
settings.inputs_empty: No saved run configuration yet; input files appear here after the first run.
settings.launcher_detail: The product UI is loopback-first. Bridgeboard is a development/runtime adapter, not a product dependency.
settings.no_issues: No reference or runtime issues require attention.
settings.reference_missing: No local reference FASTA was found for this workspace.
settings.selected_diagnostics_detail: Checks below apply only to the selected workspace.
settings.selected_no_issues: No issues found for the selected workspace.
settings.tools_detail: Same list the pipeline checks at start-up, looked up on the PATH a UI-started run sees: this process's PATH with the run Python's directory in front.

site_scores.no_sources_detail: This workspace has no saved run configuration. Finish a run first.

site_scores.off_title: This run did not score sites
site_scores.reference_note: Scores annotate sites only: counts, filtering and annotation are unchanged.

site_scores.unsupported_title: This run's annotation format is not supported
site_scores.verified_detail: Both tables match the SHA256 digests recorded by the scoring stage. This is a file check, not the sealed agent reader.

igv.preset.label: Track preset
igv.preset.hint: Core loads transcripts, both coverage strands and final sites. Other tracks download only when selected. Selection resets to Core on Load IGV.
igv.browser.partial: Loaded {count}; some selected tracks failed. Check the IGV message.
igv.browser.empty_selection: No tracks are loaded. Choose All or Custom to select available tracks.

page.subtitle.run_evidence: Inspect native measurements and export a source-linked extract.
evidence.intro: Select a completed run, choose a native table and filter exact gene, cell or site identifiers. Each query creates its own source snapshot and report.
evidence.no_runs: No completed executions in this workspace. Register the native output root in Workspaces, then refresh Runs.
evidence.no_tables: No supported terminal-aware tables in the projected output namespaces. Check Summarize outputs and the native logs.
evidence.recover: Refresh Runs, select the latest completed execution, and verify its terminal-aware summary files. No historical result is inferred from a shared directory.
evidence.filter_help: Blank filters include all values. Filters must exist in the selected table. Zero and NA remain distinct.
evidence.preparing: Verifying the run and hashing the selected source…
evidence.confirm_detail: Copy and verify the selected native table, then read it in a background task. The report contains the filtered rows and provenance.
evidence.cost_detail: At most 128 MiB compressed, 2 GiB expanded, 15 million rows and 120 seconds. Report exports at most 500 matching rows. No BAM processing.
evidence.working: Source verification and table reading run in the background. You may leave this page and return to the saved query.
evidence.truncated: The report contains the first 500 matches in source order. Narrow your filters or download the full source snapshot.
evidence.failed_help: Partial files and logs are preserved. Correct the cause, preview again and start a new query; previous attempts are retained.
evidence.snapshot_note: Current retained files are captured at query time. The invocation/config association does not certify an immutable execution-time snapshot.
evidence.science_note: Native rows are preserved exactly, including NA and zero. Distal usage is D/T. More called sites alone do not establish usable terminal APA; these extracts do not perform atlas or quality assessment.
evidence.choose_execution: The requested execution is unavailable here. Choose a completed execution; no other run has been substituted.
evidence.error.invalid_input: Cannot read this selection. Check the completed execution, table and exact filters.
evidence.error.worker_failed: The query stopped before completion. Check the saved details and log, then preview a new attempt.
evidence.error.source_changed: The source changed after preview. Refresh Runs and preview again.
evidence.error.source_missing: The saved source or download is missing. Restore it or select another query.
evidence.error.budget: This selection exceeds the read budget. Select a smaller table or scope.
evidence.error.filter: The table does not support these filters. Clear the unavailable fields or select a matching table.
evidence.error.matrix_filter: Enter an exact cell barcode to query the dense matrix. Use a long table for a gene query.
evidence.error.busy: An evidence query is still running. Wait for it to finish before starting another.
evidence.error.result_changed: Saved query bytes changed. Download refused; inspect this attempt or create a new query.
evidence.preview_download: Preview and download a verified snapshot
analysis.title: Native analyses
analysis.intro: Choose saved executions, a fixed cohort and references. Preview the source bindings and cost before starting a new analysis.
analysis.method.cs2.qc_compare: Paired PAS quality and APA sensitivity
analysis.description.cs1.fixed_coverage_: Preserve every supplied cell and gene-strand unit, including zero counts. Export the complete coverage report and native distal source.
analysis.description.cs2.qc_compare: Compare two executions on the same source and references, changing one scientific parameter. QC, masks and APA eligibility remain descriptive.
analysis.verifying: Verifying recorded sources and input bytes…
analysis.error: The analysis could not proceed. Review the selection and saved technical details.
analysis.runtime_note: Recorded provenance is checked against the selected jobs. Its capture time and evidence limits remain in the report.
analysis.budget: {cpu} CPU · {memory} GiB memory limit · {seconds} s hard time limit
analysis.fixed_scope: The supplied cohort and units stay fixed. No automatic retry follows a failure.
analysis.confirm_body: Create a new task using the previewed sources and fixed method. Full tables and provenance are retained; failures preserve partial output.
analysis.method.cs3.candidates: Atlas, sequence and native risk evidence
analysis.description.cs3.transform: Transform explicitly declared atlas coordinates with pinned chain and size tables; conserve all input rows.
analysis.description.cs3.project: Build an accounted reference from a successful transform and an explicit sequence contract.
analysis.description.cs3.candidates: Assess saved sites against the projected reference. Atlas absence, sequence risk and stored native risk remain separate.
analysis.cs3_contract: Coordinate base and assembly are declared. UCSC chrM conservative exclusion is fixed; projection source positions are normalized to 1-based, distinct from the raw atlas declaration.
analysis.field.name: Atlas name
analysis.json_help: Browse records and nested fields in pages of 25. Open a row to inspect every nested field; Root and Parent return to its context. Values retain JSON types: null, true/false and quoted strings (including "NA") remain distinct. Collection lengths count records or fields, not cells.
analysis.json_context_help: Up to 20 simple fields (scalars and short arrays) per ancestor are listed here. Parent navigation exposes every field and nested collection. Source paths use JSON Pointer (zero-based array positions).
analysis.json_transition_note: Each outer row is a cohort/mode/definition/cutoff block. Open its transitions array for the four qualification contingency cells. The array length is not a cell count.
analysis.json_composition_note: Choose a metric, then strata for the complete paginated stratum records. Other metric fields retain denominators, exclusions and the interpretation.
analysis.recovery.label: Export recovery
analysis.recovery.title: Recover a failed export
analysis.recovery.description: Select a failed CS3 candidate export. Verify completed science and its original files before creating a separate export-only attempt. The original failure remains in its source workspace.
analysis.recovery.confirm_body: Create one separate export attempt using the verified completed science. This does not recompute science. The original FAILED task and damaged archive are preserved.
analysis.recovery.succeeded: Computation complete · original export failed · export recovered
analysis.recovery.origin: Original FAILED task: {task} · scientific computation was not rerun
analysis.recovery.failure: Computation completed, but the large-file export failed. A separate export recovery is required.
analysis.details_help: Read original fields from the successful recovered report. Open a table row for complete support, reference, sequence and unavailable-channel details. JSONL positions are zero-based in navigation; the source label shows its one-based file line. Objects, arrays, null, empty strings and absent fields are distinct.
analysis.details_origin: Recovered report: {task} · original science task: {source} (original failure retained)
